correctness.rationale: The difference recurrence gives precisely three nonzero three-periodic kernel shifts when 3 divides the ring size and no nonzero shift otherwise. For each nonzero difference, the pair of no-adjacent-one constraints forces exactly two allowable patterns in each three-site block, independently: 2^k allowed first endpoints, hence 2^(k-1) unordered pairs. Pair-pattern intersections give exactly one triple predecessor fiber of the all-one output; no larger fibers exist. Counting collision edges and Lucas source states proves the histogram and capacity. The delivered checker exhaustively confirms all indexed cyclic inputs through n=21; the proof, not those tests, handles unbounded n and n=1,2.

value.rationale: Hard-core no-adjacent-one words are the standard Fibonacci constrained source in symbolic coding; three-neighbor parity is the standard additive Rule 150 sensor. Exact bounded preimage lists, the single threefold ambiguity and exact zero-error distinguishability are natural all-length reconstruction quantities that cannot be obtained merely from the full-shift fourfold count or Lucas population formula; they give a complete classification, not an arbitrary finite parameter slice. The asymptotically vanishing ambiguous-source fraction is a meaningful noise-free recovery conclusion.
